problem: Automation-only terminal closure produced production_readback_mode=github_main, but the durable Supabase evidence ingest rejected that mode with HTTP 422.
root_cause: The producer contract in obligation-terminal-closure.yml evolved without the consumer validation contract in growth-datahub-ingest being updated in the same lineage.
prevention: Treat terminal evidence readback modes as a shared producer-consumer contract.
Accept github_main only with a valid observed SHA and explicit production_readback_verified=true.
Persist github_main with a dedicated github-main:<sha> remote reference instead of pretending it is a deployment descendant.
Keep a regression test that reads both workflow and Supabase consumer contract.
